objective_value: <float> Total operating cost including driver salaries, vehicle operating costs, employee salaries, and setup costs.

routes.vehicle: <int> Identifier of the vehicle assigned to this route.

trips.trip: <int> Sequential index of this trip within the vehicle's route.

trips.start_period: <int> Period index at which this trip departs from the depot.

setups_by_product_subperiod.subperiod: <int> Valid production subperiod ID for the product.
setups_by_product_subperiod.setups: <int> Number of employees starting a setup in this product/subperiod.
